reason: Repeals 15(d1) reasonableness limitation, restoring High Court review of government/minister decisions; strengthens court power against elected officials, not judicial self-governance itself.
Requires 90-MK majority to amend Basic Law Human Dignity and Judiciary 15(c)-(d), shielding court jurisdiction and rights review from political majority changes.
Transfers judge selection to Knesset members, judges only advisory on committee, plus Knesset hearings for Supreme Court candidates: more elected control over judiciary.

Legislates random Supreme Court panel assignment, removing Chief Justice's discretion over panels; externally constrains judicial leadership's internal administration, no direct elected-official power.
